verses.2: Indeed, you are a people, and with you there will be wisdom.
verses.3: I also have a heart like theirs. I will not fall away from them. And no one else can be compared to them.
verses.4: Speak to your enemy, and he will call upon the Lord. Then he will answer you. Speak with a pure heart.
verses.5: Lafid Buz is suitable for making shoes that can be worn on feet.
verses.6: Let them be destroyed by those who destroy idols, and let them be punished by those who bring idols into their hands.
verses.7: But please, ask in the wilderness and in the land of drought, and in the heights of heaven. Then it will tell you.
verses.8: Or, go into the land and wander there. And the fish of the sea will tell you about it.
verses.9: Who wouldn’t know that it was the hand of Jehovah that did this?
verses.10: For in his hands lies the soul of all living things, and the spirit of every person’s body.
verses.11: Now, the ears do not hear, and the mouth does not taste what to eat.
verses.12: In those days of wisdom, and for many years to come.
verses.13: With him were wisdom and nobility; he received advice and guidance from them.
verses.14: He will also not build anything, nor will he close things up for anyone. He will not open anything either.
verses.15: They will also be trapped in the water, and they will be destroyed. They will be turned into dust, and the land will become barren.
verses.16: With him are strength and courage; he is also a warrior who fights and defeats his enemies.
verses.17: May those who give advice and judge be blessed.
verses.18: The kings’ decrees were announced, and they were prohibited in their terms.
verses.19: Many priests will be removed from their positions, and many others will be dismissed.
verses.20: Let those who speak falsely be silenced, and let the wisdom of the elders be respected.
verses.21: It pours its benefits upon the generous, and it scorns those who are ungrateful.
verses.22: It revealed the hidden depths from within me; it brought forth light from darkness.
verses.23: He destroyed the nations, and they were destroyed. He scattered them across the nations, and they became scattered.
verses.24: He took away the hearts of the leaders of the people of the land, and they became foolish, not in the right way.
verses.25: It was dark and without light. Then, it became quiet.
